summary: This note outlines Horizon Innovations' Professional Development Policy, which gives employees access to online learning platforms and e-learning resources to support continuous growth. It covers eligibility, how to request access, progress tracking, and how completed learning can lead to career advancement. The policy is reviewed regularly to reflect best practices.
one_line: Horizon Innovations' policy giving employees access to online learning platforms and e-learning resources, with eligibility rules, progress tracking, and career rewards.
key_facts: Horizon Innovations has partnered with online learning providers: Coursera, LinkedIn Learning, edX, Udemy for Business, and Skillshare.
The online platforms offer courses ranging from data analysis and coding to marketing and leadership.
Beyond online courses, employees can use e-learning resources including webinars, online conferences, virtual workshops, and podcasts.
E-learning tools let employees learn at their own pace and schedule, minimizing disruption to work commitments.
All full-time employees at Horizon Innovations are eligible for professional development benefits.
Part-time employees may be granted access on a case-by-case basis, contingent upon managerial approval.
To get started, employees request access through the internal professional development portal, discuss learning goals with their supervisor, and set a learning schedule that fits their workflow.
Successful completion of relevant courses may lead to opportunities for promotion, enhanced project involvement, and recognition through employee awards.
Employees are expected to track their progress and share regular updates with supervisors.
Certifications or credentials earned through online courses should be documented in the internal tracking system.
Documented professional development can be factored into performance evaluations.
The policy is subject to ongoing review and improvement to reflect best practices in e-learning and professional development.
